title: Reaching for Yield and the Cross Section of Bond Returns
eligible_reason: The only DiD (Table 8) compares yields of high reaching-for-yield bonds (treat) with 5-nearest-neighbour propensity-score-matched bonds around the QE1 announcement (event), estimated window by window with reg yield treat event treat*event and no bond or time FE. Single event, matching-based, no TWFE. The paper's main analyses are portfolio sorts and pooled return regressions on continuous RFY measures.
design_notes: Corporate bond-month panel (TRACE/Mergent-derived). Tables 2-3 portfolio sorts; Tables 4-6 reghdfe of cumulative future returns on rfywr_highdummy with bond characteristics, date and firm FE, Driscoll-Kraay SE; Table 5 downgrades/defaults; Table 7 institutional holdings changes. Table 8 (Output.do lines 296-329): psmatch2 treat rating tmt ztd, n(5) within each QE window, then reg yield treat event mix by period (1, 2, 3, 5) and pooled, vce(cluster bond).
main_or_robustness: robustness/mechanism (DiD is one table; not staggered)
n_adoption_cohorts_note: One event (QE1 announcement) in the DiD table.
data_access: partial (processed datasets for Tables 2, 3 and 8 shipped; raw bond data licensed and not shipped)
data_files_note: README: processed data only for Tables 2, 3 and 8; other tables have code and logs only.
data_provenance_note: Processed real data for the shipped tables (not described as synthetic).
software_notes: SAS (Process.sas) for data processing; Stata (Output.do) for tables.
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text in data/text). Package contents read, no code run.
